# Benchmarks

Measuring how long code takes per iteration, and keeping its results alive.

<h2 id="benchmark-case"><code>BenchmarkCase</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct BenchmarkCase {
    pub name: char8[..];
    pub run: func(uint64);
}
```

A benchmark: its name, which the runner reports and filters on, and the function that repeats the measured work
as many times as it is told. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L17)

**Fields**

| Name   | Type           | Description                                            |
| ------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name` | `char8[..]`    | The benchmark's name, such as `Parser::SmallDocument`. |
| `run`  | `func(uint64)` | Runs the measured work the given number of times.      |

<h2 id="benchmark-result"><code>BenchmarkResult</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct BenchmarkResult {
    pub iterations: uint64;
    pub elapsed: Duration;
}
```

What a measurement found: how many iterations its final run made and how long that run took. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L26)

**Fields**

| Name         | Type       | Description                                |
| ------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `iterations` | `uint64`   | How many iterations the measured run made. |
| `elapsed`    | `Duration` | How long the measured run took.            |

**Methods**

<h3 id="benchmark-result-nanoseconds-per-iteration"><code>NanosecondsPerIteration</code></h3>

```rux
pub func NanosecondsPerIteration(self: &BenchmarkResult) -> float64
```

The average time one iteration took, in nanoseconds.

**Returns**: the time per iteration, or zero for a run of no iterations

<h2 id="benchmark-options"><code>BenchmarkOptions</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct BenchmarkOptions {
    pub filter: char8[..];
    pub minimumTime: Duration;
    pub maximumIterations: uint64;
}
```

Which benchmarks a run chooses and how long each is measured. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L46)

**Fields**

| Name                | Type        | Description                                                                                        |
| ------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filter`            | `char8[..]` | Run only benchmarks whose names hold this text, or every benchmark when it is empty.               |
| `minimumTime`       | `Duration`  | How long the measured run must last, at the least.                                                 |
| `maximumIterations` | `uint64`    | The most iterations one run makes, which ends the growth for work too fast to reach `minimumTime`. |

Options that measure every benchmark for at least 200 milliseconds and at most a billion iterations.

<h2 id="consume"><code>Consume&lt;T&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Consume<T>(value: *T)
```

Marks `value` as used, so the work that computed it is not removed as having no effect.
It stores the value's address where the compiler cannot see it read, which costs one store.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L73)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description      |
| ---- | ---------------- |
| `T`  | the value's type |

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type | Description        |
| ------- | ---- | ------------------ |
| `value` | `*T` | the result to keep |

<h2 id="measure"><code>Measure</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Measure(
    run: func(uint64),
    options: BenchmarkOptions
) -> BenchmarkResult
```

Runs `run` with a growing iteration count until one run lasts at least `options.minimumTime` or reaches
`options.maximumIterations`, and reports that run.
Each next count aims a little past the minimum from the rate measured so far, growing at least twofold and at
most a hundredfold, so a measurement makes few runs whatever the work costs.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L85)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type               | Description                                    |
| --------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `run`     | `func(uint64)`     | the work, repeated as many times as it is told |
| `options` | `BenchmarkOptions` | how long to measure                            |

**Returns**: the final run's iterations and time

<h2 id="run-benchmarks-with"><code>RunBenchmarksWith</code></h2>

```rux
pub func RunBenchmarksWith(
    benchmarks: BenchmarkCase[..],
    options: BenchmarkOptions
) -> int
```

Measures the benchmarks that `options` choose, in order, and reports each as its time per iteration and the
iterations it was measured over, then how many were measured.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L118)

**Parameters**

| Name         | Type                | Description                               |
| ------------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `benchmarks` | `BenchmarkCase[..]` | the benchmarks                            |
| `options`    | `BenchmarkOptions`  | which to run and how long to measure each |

**Returns**: 0

<h2 id="run-benchmarks"><code>RunBenchmarks</code></h2>

```rux
pub func RunBenchmarks(benchmarks: BenchmarkCase[..]) -> int
```

Measures the benchmarks the process's arguments choose. A plain argument is a filter that a benchmark's name must
hold, and `--quick` measures each for 10 milliseconds rather than 200, for checking that benchmarks still run.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Benchmark.rux#L137)

**Parameters**

| Name         | Type                | Description    |
| ------------ | ------------------- | -------------- |
| `benchmarks` | `BenchmarkCase[..]` | the benchmarks |

**Returns**: 0, or 2 for arguments it does not understand
